Property.name: SteamID64
Property.HelpText: Your 17-digit Steam ID, starting with 7656119. Your Leetify profile must be public.

Property.name: FirstRunMatches
Property.display: Matches to reward on the first run
Property.HelpText: How many of your newest matches count the very first time CounterChao runs. 1 means only your latest match.

Property.name: KeepLog
Property.HelpText: Writes CounterChao.log in the mod folder. Useful when reporting a problem.

Property.name: CloseAfterSave
Property.HelpText: When you leave Chao World through the lobby teleporter, CounterChao waits for the save to finish, then closes the game.
